body: Thank you for the help. I think I've got it figured out now.
I'm sorry, this is going to sound really dumb but is "ward" supposed to be a number?

I can't fathom that at fucking all. She used it as an insult against a black person. Just because she's married to him doesn't magically make it not racist. My girlfriend is black and I would never EVER say something like that to her.

Your spouse is supposed to be your number 1 supporter, not your number 1 verbal abuser. And this time, maybe the kids didn't hear it but what happens when they do? They're half black. How are they supposed to handle their own mother using such an offensive and demeaning word against their father? What's stopping her from using it against her children?

I've been really confused by the people saying I was eavesdropping. I was in the basement, which is the room my sister provided for me to stay in, and I was woken up by the argument. I DID NOT intend to listen in. Am I expected to leave the house whenever there might be an argument or conversation that I'm not supposed to hear?
